tasting_notes: Aguardente vínica (Arinto, Periquita, Trincadeira, Fernão Pires) aged min 6 months in oak; vanilla, apricot, peach, honey, subtle anise. (Brand owned by Pernod Ricard; production moved to Spain from 2014.)
Unaged white bagaceira from selected red-grape pomace of the Borba region; fresh, vinous, fruity, smooth.
Very old (Velhíssima) oak-aged bagaceira from Borba region pomace.
